steps: log (ngc/bugsweep) over the home shaft: the UH-1H is placed with H.reset (Z.pos is copied from the flight model each frame, so setting it moved nothing and the cave was never entered); a PI hover per game frame holds it in the cave (the UH-1H hovers at ~0.54 collective)

eval (__G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(__G.HOME_B.x+0.18, 16, __G.HOME_B.z+0.18), 0, false, 1), __G.HI.setCollective(0.3), window.__hc = 0.54, window.__hl = __G.war.time, window.__hov = setInterval(()=>{ const T=__G.T, dt = __G.war.time - __hl; if (__G.G.mode !== 'thrust' || !T.alive || T.landed) { __hl = __G.war.time; return; } if (dt <= 0) return; __hl = __G.war.time; __hc = Math.min(0.85, Math.max(0.4, __hc - T.vy * 0.3 * dt)); __G.HI.setCollective(Math.min(0.95, Math.max(0.35, __hc - T.vy * 0.03))); }, 16), 1)
